chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام.
Regarding hastening the tawaf before departing to Minā, he said: “They are the same, whether he delays that or brings it forward.”

key_terms.تَعْجِيلِ: bringing an act forward or performing it early
key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: equal in ruling, with no difference between the two options
key_terms.قَدَّمَهُ: performed it earlier or advanced it
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the hajj location to which pilgrims proceed
key_terms.ٱلطَّوَافِ: the ritual circumambulation performed in hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform the tawaf before departing to Minā, or must it be delayed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the timing of tawaf in relation to departure for Minā during hajj. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام states that performing it earlier or delaying it is equal, indicating permissibility in both timings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2778 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari, from Abu al-Hasan (as), regarding performing the tawaf early before going to Mina.
Imam (as) said: "It is the same, whether he delays it or performs it earlier."
